comparison.objective: Screen media from finished parts vs remove a tote whose strap is caught on a rake.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular-flow control through apertures vs disentangle a flexible ring/strap from a tine before transporting the tote without dragging the rake.
comparison.success_condition: Recovery fraction, washer retention, no spill, screen reseated vs ring freed, rake remains safely on shelf, tote placed and released on table.
comparison.reason: Entanglement resolution and tote transport are materially different from granular sifting.
